alapha888-agent-skills-en-code-review-ch.description: Five-axis code review checklist (correctness, security, readability, performance, test coverage) producing actionable comments instead of style nitpicks. Use when the user asks to review code, a diff, or a pull request.

alapha888-agent-skills-en-tech-writing-p.description: Proofreads English technical writing for typos, grammar slips, punctuation, terminology consistency, jargon, and structure; returns an itemized Original → Suggestion → Reason list without rewriting the whole document. Use when the user asks to proofread, polish, or review an English technical doc, README, or blog draft.
